svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 9 resources (4 spatial cards, 5 logical resources in 4 group cards) · 8 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.

not express direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
